title: CSSBench: Evaluating the Safety of Lightweight LLMs against Chinese-Specific Adversarial Patterns
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating LLM safety (adversarial robustness and over-refusal) across domains such as illegal activities, privacy, and health misinformation. It does not include a component for benchmarking religion, faith, or specific philosophical moral frameworks; it treats 'safety' as compliance with usage policies rather than an evaluation of spiritual or ethical belief systems.
